title: Sequential Equilibrium
body_html:
Sequential Equilibrium

A pair $(\beta,\mu)$ is a sequential equilibrium if it is weak Bayesian perfect and there exists a sequence of completely mixed behavioral profiles $\beta^n$ converging to $\beta$ such that the Bayes-rule beliefs $\nu_{\beta^n}$ converge to $\mu$.

Thus off-path beliefs must arise as limits of beliefs generated by fully mixed trembling strategies.

References

  • [MFoGT, Def. 6.4.5] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Sequential equilibrium as weak Bayesian perfection plus consistency from completely mixed trembles.
